results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM olist_orders_dataset;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers FROM olist_customers_dataset;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM olist_customers_dataset;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sellers FROM olist_sellers_dataset;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_products FROM olist_products_dataset;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM olist_orders_dataset WHERE order_status = 'delivered';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_orders FROM olist_orders_dataset WHERE order_status = 'canceled';
SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score)::numeric, 2) AS average_review_score FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset;
SELECT MAX(review_score) AS highest_review_score FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset;
SELECT MIN(review_score) AS lowest_review_score FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(price)::numeric, 2) AS average_price FROM olist_order_items_dataset;
SELECT MAX(price) AS highest_price FROM olist_order_items_dataset;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(freight_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_freight FROM olist_order_items_dataset;
SELECT SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment_value FROM olist_order_payments_dataset;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_payment_records FROM olist_order_payments_dataset;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reviews FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset;
SELECT DISTINCT payment_type FROM olist_order_payments_dataset ORDER BY payment_type;
SELECT DISTINCT order_status FROM olist_orders_dataset ORDER BY order_status;

SELECT order_id, order_item_id, product_id, seller_id, price
FROM olist_order_items_dataset
ORDER BY price DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT product_id, product_weight_g
FROM olist_products_dataset
ORDER BY product_weight_g DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS total_orders
FROM olist_orders_dataset
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY total_orders DESC;

SELECT c.customer_unique_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_spending
FROM olist_customers_dataset c
JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN olist_order_payments_dataset p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY total_spending DESC;
SELECT product_id, ROUND(AVG(price)::numeric, 2) AS average_price FROM olist_order_items_dataset GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY average_price DESC;

SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM olist_products_dataset
GROUP BY product_category_name
ORDER BY product_count DESC;

SELECT s.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM olist_sellers_dataset s
JOIN olist_order_items_dataset oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM olist_orders_dataset GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score)::numeric, 2) AS average_review_score
FROM olist_orders_dataset o
JOIN olist_order_reviews_dataset r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_status
ORDER BY average_review_score DESC;

SELECT seller_id, ROUND(SUM(freight_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_freight
FROM olist_order_items_dataset
GROUP BY seller_id
ORDER BY total_freight DESC;

SELECT payment_type, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment_amount
FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY total_payment_amount DESC;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS total_orders
FROM olist_orders_dataset
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS total_item_revenue
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT customer_city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM olist_customers_dataset
GROUP BY customer_city
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

SELECT oi.seller_id, COUNT(*) AS items_sold
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
ORDER BY items_sold DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category_name,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.freight_value)::numeric, 2) AS avg_freight
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_products_dataset p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
  ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
ORDER BY avg_freight DESC;

SELECT s.seller_state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders
FROM olist_orders_dataset o
JOIN olist_order_items_dataset oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN olist_sellers_dataset s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY s.seller_state
ORDER BY delivered_orders DESC;

SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(payment_installments)::numeric, 2) AS avg_installments
FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY avg_installments DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM olist_products_dataset p
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
  ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000
ORDER BY product_count DESC;
SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset GROUP BY review_score ORDER BY review_score;

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category_name,
       SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.customer_unique_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_spending
FROM olist_customers_dataset c
JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN olist_order_payments_dataset p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(AVG(ot.total_payment)::numeric, 2) AS average_order_value
FROM olist_orders_dataset o
JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment
    FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
    GROUP BY order_id
) ot ON o.order_id = ot.order_id
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category_name,
       SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
ORDER BY revenue_rank;

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_spending
    FROM olist_customers_dataset c
    JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN olist_order_payments_dataset p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT customer_unique_id, total_spending
FROM customer_spending
WHERE total_spending > (SELECT AVG(total_spending) FROM customer_spending)
ORDER BY total_spending DESC;
SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage_of_orders FROM olist_orders_dataset GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

WITH product_revenue AS (
  SELECT p.product_id,
         p.product_category_name,
         SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
  FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
  JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_category_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT pr.product_id,
         pr.product_category_name,
         pr.total_revenue,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pr.product_category_name ORDER BY pr.total_revenue DESC) AS rn
  FROM product_revenue pr
)
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, r.product_category_name) AS category_name,
       r.product_id,
       r.total_revenue
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
  ON r.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE r.rn <= 3
ORDER BY category_name, r.total_revenue DESC;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
           SUM(p.payment_value) AS revenue
    FROM olist_orders_dataset o
    JOIN olist_order_payments_dataset p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
)
SELECT month,
       revenue,
       SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_revenue
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month;

WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment
    FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    order_id,
    total_payment
FROM order_totals
WHERE total_payment > (SELECT AVG(total_payment) FROM order_totals)
ORDER BY total_payment DESC;

SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
       MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS most_recent_order_date,
       COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders
FROM olist_customers_dataset c
JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
         SUM(p.payment_value) AS revenue
  FROM olist_orders_dataset o
  JOIN olist_order_payments_dataset p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))::numeric, 2) AS month_over_month_change
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month;
